card.name: The mL in per-5-mL strengths
card.fires_on: The unit mL (or its final letter L) right after "5" in oral liquid strengths such as "125 mg/5 mL" or "per 5 mL". It appears in dose charts and descriptions of oral suspensions and solutions.
